args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy - rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate after the latest deploy. Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release v2.3.0 in all regions. Monitoring to confirm recovery.

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

**Investigation:**
- `checkout-api` was running **v2.3.1** in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), with health checks failing and an 18% error rate.
- Deployment history showed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release; the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0** (v2.2.9 was older).

**Actions taken:**
1. **Rolled back** `checkout-api` to **v2.3.0** in all production regions — confirmed rolled out across us-east, us-west, and eu-west.
2. **Opened SEV2 incident** INC-0001 ("checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy - rolled back to v2.3.0"), which paged the on-call engineer, describing the failure and the rollback.

**Verification:**
- Post-rollback status shows `checkout-api` on v2.3.0 in all regions, **healthy** with error rate down to 0.2%.

Note: the rollback to v2.3.0 was a previously healthy production version, so no change-manager approval was required. The incident remains open for follow-up on the root cause of the v2.3.1 regression.
